name: Distracted Boyfriend
description: A stock photo meme showing a man turning to look at another woman while his girlfriend stares at him in disbelief. It is used to represent someone abandoning or becoming distracted from one thing in favor of another.

useCases.name: Choosing a New Favorite
useCases.description: The boyfriend represents a person, the girlfriend is the current choice, and the other woman is the newly preferred option.

useCases.name: Abandoning Responsibilities
useCases.description: Used to joke about ignoring work, school, or obligations for something more enjoyable.

useCases.name: Technology Trends
useCases.description: Represents users or companies switching from an old technology, framework, or product to a newer one.

useCases.name: Consumer Preferences
useCases.description: Shows customers losing interest in one product after discovering a better alternative.
